principles: Human leads — AI assists
Control before automation
Ownership always protected
Ethics built in — not added later
No loop behavior
Clear output only
Multi-platform ready
Track everything: learning, credentials, documents, operations and money
Simple experience — powerful system underneath
Sustainable growth only
Consent is granular and revocable where applicable
Privacy by architecture, not by promise
Least privilege and zero-trust access
Every credential is independently verifiable
Every policy and consent is versioned
Every important administrative action is auditable
Cultural provenance stays attached to knowledge
Public examples are separated from protected curriculum
AI recommends and routes; authorized humans decide spiritual and credential matters
Resilience, accessibility, portability and recovery are designed in from day one

privacy.member_profile: Member controls what is entered and whether the basic profile is public or private.
privacy.ministry_profile: Minister controls optional public-facing ministry description subject to church policy.
privacy.verification: Separate minimum-data official record; never exposes account or private profile data.
security: encryption in transit and at rest when backend is implemented

training.public_content: Examples and previews only unless specifically designated public.

ordination.scope: Foundational recognition of calling with limited practice under church/site name according to church policy; does not equal completion of an advanced minister track.
ordination.recommendation: Continue into Christian Minister/Pastor, Holy Person Minister or Plant Minister training.

charter.annual_good_standing_renewal: small fee set by church administration

business_under_hood.purpose: Support church sustainability without turning the spiritual experience into a storefront.
baskets: approved merchandise or future church resources
controls: free spiritual recognition remains separate from optional paid documentation
track revenue and cost by basket

AI_governance.safety: Health, legal and controlled-substance material is educational/policy content and must not be converted into autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dosing, sourcing or legal guarantees.
